Name: Geopositioning Information
Description: The GEOPS TRE defines (possibly associated with the PRJPS extension) the absolute coordinate system to which the data is geo-referenced. This absolute coordinate system may be a geographic system or a cartographic (grid) coordinate system. The user-defined fields of the GEOPS extension are detailed in Table P-2. A single GEOPS shall be placed in either the XHD field (or corresponding TRE_OVERFLOW DES) of a NSIF or NITF file main header, when the content of the GEOPS extension applies to the entire dataset, or in the IXSHD field (or corresponding TRE_OVERFLOW DES) of an individual Image Segment Subheader, if the GEOPS extension information only applies to that Image Segment (and any other Image Segments associated with that Image Segment).

TYP.Name: Coordinate System Type
TYP.Description: This field shall contain the type of coordinate system to which the Image Segment refers. Valid values are GEO for a geographic coordinate system (longitude and latitude), MAP for a cartographic (grid) coordinate system (Easting and Northing) and DIG for a geographic or cartographic coordinate system registered through location grids or registration points. See clause P.3.2 for details. The default value is MAP.

UNI.Name: Coordinate Units
UNI.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure to which the Image Segment refers. Valid values are SEC (decimal seconds of arc), DEG (decimal degrees), and M (meters). The value must be consistent with the coordinate system type. SEC and DEG are not allowed when the coordinate system type is MAP. M is not allowed when the coordinate system type is GEO. The PRJPSB extension is expected when the value is M. The default value is M.

DAG.Name: Geodetic Datum Name
DAG.Description: This field shall contain the name of the geodetic datum to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is World Geodetic System 1984. See Table P-17 (originally from Table 6-2, DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-6) for a list of geodetic datums.

DCD.Name: Geodetic Datum Code
DCD.Description: This field shall contain the code of the geodetic datum to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is WGE (i.e., WGS 84).

ELL.Name: Ellipsoid Name
ELL.Description: This field shall contain the name of the ellipsoid to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is World Geodetic System 1984.

Values: US - Modified Airy UK - Airy Modified
US - Everest (Brunei and E. Malaysia (Sabah and Sarawak))

ELC.Name: Ellipsoid Code
ELC.Description: This field shall contain the code of the ellipsoid to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is WE (i.e., WGS 84).

DVR.Name: Vertical Datum Reference
DVR.Description: This field shall contain the name of the vertical datum reference to which the Image Segment refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no elevation value appears in the Image Segment. The default value is Geodetic, which means that elevations in the dataset are referenced to the ellipsoid of the specified geodetic datum, i.e., they are ellipsoidal heights.

VDCDVR.Name: Code (Category) of Vertical Reference
VDCDVR.Description: This field shall contain the code (or category) of the vertical reference to which the Image Segment refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no elevation value appears in the Image Segment. The default code is GEOD, which means that elevations in the dataset are referenced to the ellipsoid of the specified geodetic datum, i.e., they are ellipsoidal heights.

SDA.Name: Sounding Datum Name
SDA.Description: This field shall contain the name of the sounding datum to which the Image Segment refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no sounding appears in the Image Segment. The default value is Mean Sea.

Values: Local Datum (arbitrary datum defined by local harbour authority)

VDCSDA.Name: Code for Sounding Datum
VDCSDA.Description: This field shall contain the code of the sounding datum to which the Image Segment refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no sounding appears in the Image Segment. The default valid code is MSL.

ZOR.Name: Z Values False Origin
ZOR.Description: This field shall contain the elevation and depth false origin for Z values to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is 000000000000000, which implies that there is no projection false Z origin.

GRD.Name: Grid Code
GRD.Description: This field shall contain the identification code of the grid system to which the Image Segment refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20). The default is all BCS spaces (0x20).

GRN.Name: Grid Description
GRN.Description: This field can contain a text description of the grid system if the GRD field value is not all BCS spaces (0x20). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

ZNA.Name: Grid Zone Number
ZNA.Description: This field shall contain the zone number when the GRD field contains a significant grid code and the corresponding grid system comprises more than one zone; defaulted to 0000 otherwise. The default value is 0000.
